Tests pass only because they send the replay shape. Reproduced by three subagents.

PodDrift answers nil for a gone pod; while claims still record it, the drift-cleared branch posts Replaced=false and skips podWentWithoutItsRound: carry-on sent to the new pod's workers, lost work unreported. Reproduced.

A nothing-replaced end that lands between agent_end and prompt_result is not held (claim idle); leaveRound keeps the confirmed ask, nothing is sent, prompt_result retires it: worker never released. Reproduced.

staleClaim refuses a no-install claim on an old contract outside a round ('the daemon is relaunching this process'), but nothing relaunches it now; refused from boot to the first sweep, forever on a daemon-only release. Reproduced (ready=409, relaunches=0).
